title: HomeFlood Additional Coverages and Loss Settlement Terms by Tier
content:
Under **HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies**, each tier fixes the loss-of-use benefit, the basis on which dwelling and personal property losses are settled, and the sublimits for finished basements, in-ground pools and loss-avoidance costs.

| Tier | Loss of use limit (USD per occurrence) | Longest loss of use period (calendar months after the date of loss) | Dwelling replacement cost settlement available | Insurance-to-value share for replacement cost (percent of the dwelling replacement cost value) | Personal property settlement basis | Finished basement sublimit (USD per occurrence) | Pool repair sublimit (USD per occurrence) | Loss avoidance reimbursement (USD per occurrence, no deductible) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Renters | 5,000 (5000) | 6 | no | 80 | actual cash value | 0 | 0 | 1,000 (1000) |
| HomeFlood Essential | 0 | 0 | no | 80 | actual cash value | 0 | 0 | 1,000 (1000) |
| HomeFlood Standard | 10,000 (10000) | 6 | yes | 80 | actual cash value | 10,000 (10000) | 0 | 2,500 (2500) |
| HomeFlood Plus | 25,000 (25000) | 12 | yes | 80 | replacement cost | 25,000 (25000) | 10,000 (10000) | 2,500 (2500) |
| HomeFlood Premier | 50,000 (50000) | 12 | yes | 80 | replacement cost | 50,000 (50000) | 15,000 (15000) | 5,000 (5000) |
| HomeFlood Estate | 100,000 (100000) | 24 | yes | 80 | replacement cost | 100,000 (100000) | 25,000 (25000) | 5,000 (5000) |

## Terms of the schedule

- **Loss of use** is additional living expense while the home is uninhabitable after a covered flood, paid up to the tier's limit and for no longer than the tier's period counted in calendar months from the date of loss. A tier showing 0 provides none.
- **Dwelling replacement cost** is available only on tiers marked "yes", and there only when the dwelling limit reaches the insurance-to-value share (80 percent) of the dwelling replacement cost value.
- **Personal property** is settled on the tier's basis: actual cash value on HomeFlood Renters, Essential and Standard; replacement cost on HomeFlood Plus, Premier and Estate.
- **Finished basement**: the sublimit covers finished basement walls, floors and the contents kept there; a sublimit of 0 means basement items are limited to those the policy lists.
- **Pool repair** covers repair, refill and debris removal of an in-ground swimming pool.
- **Loss avoidance** reimburses sandbags, pumps and moving property to protect it, with no deductible.

*Hypothetical illustration:* on a HomeFlood Plus policy with a dwelling replacement cost value of 400,000 USD, the insurance-to-value share is 80 percent of that value, 320,000 USD; a dwelling limit of 320,000 USD reaches it and a dwelling limit of 319,000 USD does not.
